title: Tier-OFF reset final acknowledgement reports generic failure after settings already applied
outcome: An exhausted final containment acknowledgement reports a typed applied-with-held-state outcome and preserves the exact unresolved exclusions.
acceptance: A regression exhausts the shared reset budget after settings commit and verifies a typed post-commit outcome without releasing unacknowledged containment.
Existing pre-commit refusal and confirmed-containment release semantics remain intact.
